description: POST /v1/merchants/me/smart-accounts - registers the signed-in merchant's smart account so its sponsored operations are attributed to this merchant, including earlier unattributed ones from the same sender. auth_verify_otp already does this on every sign-in; call it when that sign-in reported smartAccountRegistered: false. Idempotent. 409: the address is already claimed by another merchant. Requires a fresh JWT.
name: smart_account_register
title: Register the merchant smart account
